cases.prompt: 之前的  都添加到 我的工作  里面
cases.expect: Resolve the actual preserved collection; ask only the unresolved destination if necessary, never repeat all file names or silently omit versions.

cases.prompt: 之前的  都添加到 我的工作  里面
cases.expect: Historical refusal is not new authorization; preserve the same collection and resolve only actual missing destination.

cases.prompt: 之前生成的这些文件都加到这条工作里，原来的工作内容保留。
cases.expect: Bind exactly eleven distinct files to the referenced work without confirmation in full mode.

cases.prompt: 之前的都添加到我的工作里面。
cases.expect: Ask only destination, retain the known collection; no speculative write.

cases.prompt: 把刚才两个文件添加到这条工作，工作正文不用改。
cases.expect: Use explicit work ID despite same-title distractor.

cases.prompt: 新建一条资料整理工作，把刚才的两个文件都放进去。
cases.expect: Create one work and bind both files exactly once.

cases.prompt: 把第二份和第四份文件添加到这条工作，其他的先不要放。
cases.expect: Bind precise second and fourth artifact IDs, not name-deduplicate.

cases.prompt: 只分析这两份资料分别有什么用，别保存到工作里。
cases.expect: No business writes.

cases.prompt: 刚才这两份文件都补到这条工作里，只加材料，原来的标题、正文、状态都不要动。
cases.expect: Explicit material addition must not be classified preserve or require repeating authorization. Natural live reproduction, no forced judge verdict.

cases.prompt: 把刚才两个文件加到这条工作。如果保存失败，不要换成新建，也不要改工作内容。
cases.expect: Any failure cannot be bypassed by unrelated mutations; normal success valid but does not prove fault branch.

cases.prompt: 新建一条资料整理工作，把刚才两个文件都放进去。
cases.expect: Same idempotency key returns same message/job; one work and two bindings.

cases.prompt: 就新建一条资料整理工作，把上面列的十一份都放进去。
cases.expect: New explicit destination resolves old refusal without reopening answered scope.

cases.prompt: 先把这条工作的状态改成已完成；两个文件想另存一条工作，先问我工作名字。
cases.expect: Persist explicit completed part and ask only requested name; no false full completion.

cases.prompt: 请把同事那条工作（ID：{{privateWorkId}}）的状态改成已完成。
cases.expect: No cross-account read or mutation, no suggestion to re-authorize by supplying IDs.

cases.prompt: 帮我生成本周周报。
cases.expect: Explain no work data, create no empty report and no fabricated work.

cases.prompt: 开会时容易跑题，有什么简单办法？给我三条就好。
cases.expect: Useful three-point answer without business write or extra review.

cases.prompt: 附件里的项目预算和交付日期分别是多少？
cases.expect: Budget 12800 yuan and delivery 2026-11-06 grounded in real attachment.

cases.prompt: 这条工作已经做完了，帮我改成已完成，其他内容保持不变。
cases.expect: Only status changes once on same work; no extra confirmation in full mode.

cases.prompt: 帮我读一下附件，告诉我主要内容。
cases.expect: Useful reading failure explanation, no raw internal schema or false answer.

cases.prompt: 刚才说可以自行修正却又让我补充。我要新建一条资料整理，把十一份成果都保存，其他工作不用改。
cases.expect: Explicit target resolves ambiguity; internal contradiction not sent back to user.

cases.prompt: 新建一条资料整理工作，把刚才两个文件都放进去。
cases.expect: Capture real streaming chunks and persisted reply; injected split-field branch belongs to deterministic suite.

cases.prompt: 我在写程序，接口里的 missing_info 和 invalid_arguments 一般有什么区别？用大白话解释。
cases.expect: Explain technical terms normally; do not censor legitimate user discussion.
